evals.expected_output: PR 5776 was opened by someone else, so step 1 resolves respond-only mode. Steps 5 and 6 are skipped entirely: there is nothing to apply, nothing to commit, nothing to push and no changeset. expectations: The response identifies the mode as respond-only
The response does not state or imply that it will apply fixes
No file in the repository was edited, and no commit or push was made
No changeset was proposed
The triage table is rendered before any reply is posted or thread resolved
The output names which sources ran, so an empty table is not mistaken for a PR with no feedback

expectations: The response stops and says the PR is merged or closed
No reply was posted and no thread was resolved
No file in the repository was edited, and no commit or push was made

evals.expected_output:
PRECONDITION: PR 5777 is the user's own, on branch `feat/DST-1665-listview-selection`, and that branch is NOT checked out. Run this from any other branch. If it happens to be checked out the run resolves plain author mode instead and the case is inconclusive.

The previous prompt read 'on my own PR while I have a different branch checked out', which named no PR and stated the precondition as narration rather than setup.

Author mode, no apply: the skill asks the user to switch to the branch and re-run, and until then every apply row becomes needs-human. Replies do not need the code, fixes do. The skill must not check the branch out itself, because swapping someone's worktree is the largest side effect in the pass.
expectations: The response identifies the mode as author with no apply
The response asks the user to switch to the branch and re-run
No git checkout or branch switch was performed by the skill
Every row that would otherwise be an apply is marked needs-human
No file in the repository was edited, and no commit or push was made
